about.title: Where Craftsmanship Meets Reliability
about.p1: For over a decade, WELLSHINEGOLD has been a trusted jewelry manufacturing partner for retailers Jewelry retailers around the world. Our factory combines traditional craftsmanship with modern production technology.
about.p2: From design concept to final packaging, we handle every step in-house, ensuring consistent quality, competitive pricing, and reliable delivery for your brand.
about.p3: Every piece undergoes 100% quality inspection before shipping. Our team works closely with you to bring your designs to life, or help you create something new from scratch.

services.label: Our Services
services.title: End-to-End Manufacturing
services.subtitle: Comprehensive jewelry manufacturing services tailored to your brand's needs.

items.title: OEM Manufacturing
items.desc: Send us your designs or samples. We produce to your exact specifications with precision tooling.

items.title: ODM Design
items.desc: Our design team creates original pieces based on your brand identity and target market preferences.

items.title: Packaging Services
items.desc: We specialize in jewelry production. If you need professional packaging, we can help you buy or order any packaging.We make no profit from packaging — you only pay the packaging cost and shipping fees.When you order jewelry from us, this service is free.

items.title: Quality Certification
items.desc: Every piece of jewelry goes through multiple quality checks to ensure you receive perfect quality.

features.label: Why Choose Us
features.title: The WELLSHINEGOLD Advantage
features.subtitle: Four reasons why Jewelry retailers around the world choose us as their manufacturing partner.

items.title: Factory Direct Pricing
items.desc: No middleman markup. You work directly with the manufacturer, getting the best possible price for your order volume.

items.title: Fast Turnaround
items.desc: 10-20 days for bulk orders, 5-9 days for small orders. We understand retail seasonality and meet your deadlines.

items.title: Strict Quality Control
items.desc: Every single piece is inspected before packaging. We maintain a less than 0.5% defect rate across all product lines.

items.title: Flexible MOQ
items.desc: No minimum order quantity — you can start with just 1 sample piece.Perfect for testing new designs or for small retail chains placing their first order.Even for 1 sample piece, we offer wholesale pricing.Of course, if you order in bulk, we can lower production costs and give you bigger discounts.

testimonials.subtitle: Trusted by Jewelry retailers around the world. Here's what they have to say about working with us.
